more_info.overview: Ethyl maltol is the flavouring compound 2-ethyl-3-hydroxy-4H-pyran-4-one. It resembles maltol chemically, with an ethyl group in place of maltol's methyl group. The white solid has a sweet aroma often described as caramel-like and is used in confectionery flavouring. FDA lists it as a synthetic flavouring substance under manufacturing conditions. Its flavouring role is distinct from adding colour to a food.
more_info.uses: Used in confectionery flavouring. FDA lists ethyl maltol as a synthetic flavouring substance under good manufacturing practice.
